checkedAlternates.risk: Triangles and squares are the two simplest regular polygons.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A triangle has n(n-3)/2 = 0 diagonals (group-1), whereas quadrilaterals have 2 (group-2).
A hexagon has 6×3/2 = 9 diagonals (group-3), whereas a heptagon has 14 (group-4).
